body.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
body.desc: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

body.title: Chasing 100x tokens is game of ‘irrational exuberance,’ says Polymarket CEO
body.desc: Some traders are looking for more predictable prediction market opportunities, rather than playing “hot potato” with the next 100x gem, according to Polymarket’s Shayne Coplan.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

body.title: Crypto card access doesn’t match global demand, Tangem says
body.desc: Crypto card demand can be stronger where access is harder, Tangem says, as it expands its Visa payment offering, allowing users to spend from its self-custodial wallet.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

body.title: Trump-backed WLFI plans USD1 payments for online businesses
body.desc: World Liberty Financial outlined plans to bring USD1 to major online platforms as Mesh announced a payments partnership scheduled to roll out this quarter.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

body.title: Wall Street wealth creation model is unsustainable for most participants: Hyperliquid CEO
body.desc: Early Wall Street wealth-creation opportunities remain inaccessible to retail participants, but Hyperliquid’s perpetual contracts aim to democratize access, according to its CEO.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

body.title: ‘Old money’ has stronger Bitcoin ‘diamond hands,’ says BingX exec
body.desc: BingX strategy chief Kevin Lee says wealthy investors are taking a longer-term approach to Bitcoin, though family-office crypto exposure remains limited.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

body.title: Crypto liquidations hit $550M as Bitcoin price dips below $84K
body.desc: Bitcoin fell 2.3% in two hours amid suspicion over the appearance of leveraged BTC short positions on Hyperliquid.
body.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

body.title: Bitcoin ETFs rebound with $119M inflow as Ether extends losses
body.desc: Bitcoin ETFs returned to net inflows with $119 million on Tuesday despite falling prices, while Ether funds reached a six-session outflow streak totaling $408 million.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

body.title: Bitmine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
body.desc: Tom Lee said Bitmine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

body.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
body.desc: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

body.title: DOJ invokes Bitcoin Fog ruling in potential blow to Roman Storm acquittal bid
body.desc: Prosecutors say a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling supports their argument that Tornado Cash activity in Manhattan was enough to establish venue for parts of Roman Storm’s case in New York.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

body.title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
body.desc: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

body.title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
body.desc: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

body.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
body.desc: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

body.title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
body.desc: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

body.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
body.desc: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

body.title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
body.desc: The DIGIT pilot will test distributed ledger technology and onchain settlement for UK sovereign debt, with issuance expected by the first quarter of 2027.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

body.title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
body.desc: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

body.title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
body.desc: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

body.title: Affluent investors seen boosting crypto exposure: Survey
body.desc: Most affluent investors across seven countries own and are increasing their crypto holdings despite financial advisers who remain overly cautious about digital assets.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

body.title: Bitcoin grinds toward $87K as US equities hit new record highs
body.desc: Bitcoin price action was kept in check by overhead ask liquidity while US stocks broke out to new all-time highs.
body.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

body.title: Securitize stock jumps 8% amid South Korea tokenization push
body.desc: The LG CNS partnership gives Securitize a foothold as the Seoul prepares new rules for tokenized stocks, bonds and funds beginning in February 2027.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

body.title: ECB policymaker warns of fragmentation without digital euro
body.desc: A ECB executive board member said the potential introduction of a digital euro would not ”take over the role of banks,” but ensure they have a role in the EU’s monetary system.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

body.title: Ripple expands Brevan Howard deal with prime brokerage services
body.desc: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing services to funds managed by the $35 billion alternative investment manager.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

body.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
body.desc: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

body.title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
body.desc: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March’s investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

body.title: Capital starting to rotate back to crypto from AI: Raoul Pal
body.desc: Real Vision founder Raoul Pal says a pause in the AI stock rally could help crypto attract capital, while AI agents are likely to boost Ethereum and Solana adoption.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

body.title: US crypto rules need to survive the next election
body.desc: US crypto rules could be vulnerable to political change after the midterms. Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo argues Congress needs to pass durable, bipartisan legislation.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew M. Cuomo

body.title: Paxos’ $3B USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum
body.desc: Paxos’ USDG stablecoin is now live on Arbitrum as the network proposes 100 million ARB in incentives to support adoption and liquidity.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

body.title: Polymarket overhauls smart contracts with new Protocol V2 rollout
body.desc: Polymarket begins its Protocol V2 rollout ahead of a planned November transition for new prediction markets, while existing positions remain on the current system.
body.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
